argument: The single irregular membrane must read before the six apertures read as a parts inventory. Silhouette, even-odd voids, asymmetry, and the hard perimeter must carry the composition without interface chrome.

With labels, readout, controls, rim markers, and prose hidden, the first view must leave v041's hinge register, v042's chamber body, and v043's pressure loom. It should read as a topology-bearing skin, not a blob, map, or linefield.
The visitor must attempt escape from an existing opening to the outside. Pointer, touch, keyboard, and the tear control must expose the same meaningful path without a hover-only requirement.
An interior cut and a re-entry must remain geometry-neutral. Completion must create actual remote aperture path structure, not a cursor trail, status change, or explanatory colour.
The source aperture and its path must stay exact. The split must arrive at a remote untouched aperture, proving that the skin stores the escape away from the hand.
Four remote topology splits must compound. Delete must reconstruct the exact preceding skin and release must restore the deterministic quiet seed.

A generated SVG compound path, even-odd negative space, produced secondary aperture, and seeded geometry are the medium. No screenshot, imported illustration, external font, or CSS poster may carry the work.

p5.brush is translated from programmable material production into a topology rule. Brush presets, watercolor, hatching, grain, source palette, composition, source code, examples, and API surface are refused.

v044 changes representation, composition, encounter, temporal behaviour, shape vocabulary, and viewer task: bands, chambers, and hinge routes become one negative-space membrane where only escape changes an untouched opening.

Delete v044 if the blind image is an undifferentiated blob, if an interior move commits, if re-entry commits, if the source changes, if the split is cosmetic, if later cuts reset, or if lifting is inexact.
